head: codex/201-authority-protocol-preparation
title: [v0.92][WP-04.16b1] Establish the quorum-committed authority protocol
body:
Closes #201

## Summary
- commit PrepareAuthority and FinalizeAuthority through production OpenRaft using actual applied log IDs and stable replicated polis and membership authority
- keep the current boot cut runtime-external, require exact canonical equality for every Prepare, and freeze each prepared operation's historical boot custody and digest
- retain opaque voter signer custody and runtime-owned per-node journal/CAS publication so apply returns pending until durable local reconciliation
- build and install snapshots immediately after boot rotation before a new Prepare, reject stale cuts without mutation, and reverify frozen historical finalization and publication evidence
- classify the cfg(test)-only authority contract source explicitly and route every changed production authority file through one governed adl-runtime coverage lane
- retain merge-safe v7 proof with the exact 86-case semantic contract and complete 230-test Runtime library denominator

## Coverage repair
- the original hosted failure at c5ce49147 was retained in SOR
- repeated clean 443-test runs pass the unchanged 80-percent production-file threshold
- observed minimums are authority_protocol 94.08%, identity 89.59%, polis_runtime 84.36%, and transport 92.39%
- llvm-cov scheduling varies the exact polis_runtime line count; v2 evidence retains individual run hashes and rows but explicitly makes no exact-summary reproducibility claim

## Validation
- exact authority and snapshot suite: 83/83 Rust cases
- semantic denominator: 86 selected = 11 passed, 6 reconciled, 69 rejected
- production snapshot matrix: 36/36
- full Runtime library: 230/230, zero skipped
- real three-voter OpenRaft prepare/finalize: 1/1
- legacy public-shape denial: 1/1
- strict production Clippy with warnings denied
- full-history, depth-one source-unavailable, and available-divergent validator modes
- typed validation and doctor PASS
- fresh independent exact-head review by codex:/root/review_201_coverage_truth_final: PASS, no findings

No merge is authorized until the republished exact-head checks are green.
